summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of the new European Roulette game (/games/roulette/:tableId). All 15 backend pytest tests passed including wheel-order literal match, state shape, auth requirement, bet validation (invalid types, min bet, insufficient balance), betting-phase closed rejection, history colors, ~20s betting-phase timing, and a complete round-settlement flow with straight_17/red/dozen_2 bets verifying payouts and wallet debits/credits. Frontend loaded the roulette page with wheel, table grid, chip selector, phase timer, results strip, and Your Bets area; chip-100 selection, bet placement on red/straight-17/dozen_2 all worked, wheel spun, and result popup showed correct number/color/parity/profit. Regression endpoints /api/game/state and /api/auth/me remain unchanged.

ui_bugs.issue: Chip visualization on straight-number bets uses data-testid='bet-chip-straight_17' (underscore) while the button itself uses 'bet-straight-17' (dash). Review spec expected 'bet-chip-straight-17'. Inconsistent naming; visual works.
Wallet balance in top-right does not have a data-testid (e.g. 'wallet-balance'). Balance visible as text (₹3480.00) but not selectable by testid.
During the 'spinning' phase the phase-timer element still displays 'Place Bets 00s' rather than 'Spinning...' text as described in the spec (observed at spin start; may change mid-spin). Cosmetic.

action_items: (optional) Align straight-bet chip testid to hyphen form: 'bet-chip-straight-N' to match spec (currently 'bet-chip-straight_N').
(optional) Add data-testid='wallet-balance' to header balance element for easier automation.
(optional) Ensure phase-timer explicitly shows 'Spinning...' during phase=='spinning'.
critical_code_review_comments: roulette.py engine is clean, uses secrets.randbelow(37) for fairness, correctly excludes _id from responses, atomic debit/credit via injected fns.
MIN_BET check exists but MAX_BET returns 400 with 'Maximum bet' which shares the same code path as insufficient-balance test; test still passes because message differs.
Round loop is single global asyncio task started on app startup — acceptable for single-instance deploy; will need distributed lock if horizontally scaled.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all core flows OK, minor testid gaps)
